assumptions: The unchanged saved signed vector bearing and continuous bolt-bending fields are evaluated against every original bearing and plastic-moment reference uniformly divided by the declared factor. No force, couple or field is rescaled.

NDS2024 Table12.3.1B gives mode reduction terms 3.2Ktheta,3.6Ktheta,4Ktheta with Ktheta=1+theta/360, 0<=theta<=90 degrees, for 0.25<=D<=1 inch. Its maximum 5 motivates the conservative working uniform-reference hypothesis. The table alone does not establish an ASD conversion for asymmetric three-member stacks with independent signed member couples.

These are explicit numerical material-reference hypotheses, not current assigned NDS mixed-stack capacities or a proof of a universal reduction bound. Group and geometry factors, brittle splitting, axial/torsional/washer/fitting interactions and physical compatibility remain outside this reference test.

The finite 32-cell statics witness may exceed an assumed reference without proving that every continuous statics field fails. The stored LP polygon and certificate are checked; they do not establish full-joint collapse.

The current design and six admitted first-order demands stay unchanged; no frame/native/CAD/LP solve, actual-fit work or panel/screw remedy occurs. Actual observations remain blank; no-slip support remains an assumption.
